phase: ROADMAP Stage 5: benchmark suite schema + deterministic lexical scoring skeleton v1 for anonymized real-task sets (synthetic sample fixture only)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 5 benchmark schema + scoring skeleton. load_benchmark_suite loads a suite JSON; validate_benchmark_suite checks metadata (name/version/anonymized=true) and cases[] (id/genre/prompt_fields/facts/evidence/expected_elements) with expected_elements split into facts/citations/structure/language; score_benchmark_suite scores each dimension by lexical marker coverage over a candidate answer (from responses[case_id] or the case's reference_answer) and returns per-case and aggregate dimension scores. A CLI tool tools/validate_benchmark_suite.py validates and optionally scores. A synthetic sample fixture lives at tests/data/benchmark_suite_sample.json. No real private data, no model call, no network.
implemented: backend/server.py: added BENCHMARK_DIMENSIONS and load_benchmark_suite(path) (raises ValueError on non-object / missing cases).

backend/server.py: added validate_benchmark_suite(suite) returning {passed, errors, warnings, case_count, genres, expected_element_counts}; enforces metadata name/version + anonymized=true, unique case ids, genre, prompt_fields/facts/evidence types, and expected_elements dimensions (facts/citations/structure/language); warns (not fails) on placeholder/small suites.

backend/server.py: added score_benchmark_suite(suite, responses=None) with method=benchmark_lexical_scoring_v1; per-dimension lexical marker coverage over candidate text (responses[case_id] or reference_answer), per-case + aggregate dimension means and overall mean; deterministic and JSON-serializable.
tools/validate_benchmark_suite.py: CLI delegating to the server helpers; --json and --score flags; exit 0/1/2 for pass/fail/load-error.
tests/data/benchmark_suite_sample.json: synthetic 3-case fixture (通知/报告/函) whose reference answers are authored to contain every expected marker (self-scores to 1.0).
tests/test_benchmark_suite.py: 14 tests across validation, scoring, and the CLI.
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_benchmark_suite.py and tools/validate_benchmark_suite.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; ROADMAP Stage 5 items for anonymized task-set schema and facts/citations/structure/language scoring are marked done as v1 skeletons.
not_implemented: No real anonymized task set; the fixture is synthetic placeholder data (a real 50-100 case set still needs to be built by hand).
Scoring is lexical marker coverage only, not semantic/factual/human-judgment quality; no model is invoked.
No blind evaluation harness, model/version comparison, adoption/edit-distance metrics, or regression-run automation (later Stage 5 items).
No UI, persistence, or network call.
test_status: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 256 tests OK.
python tools/validate_benchmark_suite.py --suite tests/data/benchmark_suite_sample.json --json: passed=true (with expected placeholder/<50-case warnings); --score aggregate overall=1.0.
python tools/run_quality_gates.py --json (default 'python' on PATH): passed=true, all 5 gates passed; unittest gate ran 256 tests OK.
risks: The fixture is synthetic placeholder data by design; validate flags it as placeholder/small (warnings), and it must not be mistaken for a real anonymized benchmark.

Lexical marker coverage is a coarse proxy: a candidate can score high by containing marker substrings without being correct, and can score low despite a valid paraphrase. This is an intentional deterministic skeleton, not a quality judge.
Scoring falls back to each case's reference_answer when no response is supplied, so a suite's self-score reflects fixture authoring, not model output.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified.
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
